requirements.evidence: All contract routes in routes/web.php:19-46 with correct names/middleware (password.email throttle:6,1, verification.verify signed). Login rate limit per lower(email)|ip with auth.failed/auth.throttle (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:33-63), session regenerate + redirectIntended home. Register uses str()->transliterate('register|'.$ip), 5 attempts, error on email, Registered event, login, regenerate (Register.php:28-56). Password::defaults in AppServiceProvider.php:30. Reset rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset (NewPasswordController.php:31-37); single email input in reset view. EmailVerificationRequest gives 403 on tampered id; resend skips verified users (EmailVerificationController.php:32-40). User implements MustVerifyEmail; .env.example and phpunit.xml pins present; lang/{en,pt_BR}/ui.php with Entrar/Senha/Esqueceu a senha?. Gaps: resend flashes raw 'verification-link-sent' which verify-email.blade.php:15 prints verbatim (untranslated screen text); Register uses redirectIntended rather than a plain redirect to home.

conventions.evidence: No tests at all despite 'No production code without a test' (TDD is mandatory). Livewire components validate with inline $this->validate([...]) arrays instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern (Login.php:26, Register.php:39). Positive: Bulma markup, route() everywhere, plain wire:model, CHANGELOG.md updated, Fillable attribute kept on User. README/docs not updated for the new auth setup.

security.evidence: Login rate limited inside the method (Login.php:24,47-63); register limited per IP; strict email validation; forgot-password always returns passwords.sent regardless of status (PasswordResetLinkController.php:22-24); reset rotates remember_token; logout invalidates session and regenerates token; verify uses EmailVerificationRequest (id/hash checked against logged-in user); all output escaped with {{ }}; no secrets beyond the password field that must be bound. Minor: register calls RateLimiter::hit on every submit including successful/valid ones (acceptable), no locked props needed. No exploitable flaw found.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no files under tests/; none of login, register, throttling, reset, verification tamper (403), localization or Livewire unauthorized/tamper tests are shipped.

simplicity.evidence: Lean controllers modeled on framework defaults; shared layout layouts/app.blade.php reused by Livewire ($slot) and Blade (@yield). Some duplicated form-field markup across five views that could be a Blade component (e.g. reset-password.blade.php:14-39 vs livewire/auth/register.blade.php).

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (ensureIsNotRateLimited, throttleKey), clear names, consistent formatting. Nits: layout title renders 'PegaFila - PegaFila' (layouts/app.blade.php:6 config('app.name') + ui.layout.title); layout mixes {{ $slot ?? '' }} and @yield.

scope.evidence: Changes serve the task; converting welcome/bulma-test to translations is required by req. 8/9. Minor extras: route names 'welcome'/'bulma.test' added, welcome.blade.php drops the @fonts directive, and the welcome page gains login/register/home links not asked for.

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests at all, violating the mandatory TDD convention and leaving every requirement (throttling, 403 tamper, locale strings, unauthorized Livewire calls) unverified.
Livewire components validate with inline rule arrays instead of the project's required #[Validate] attributes on public properties.

The resend flash is the raw key 'verification-link-sent', which the view prints verbatim, so the user sees untranslated, hardcoded text contrary to the 'all screen text from translation files' requirement.
Register uses redirectIntended instead of redirecting to home as specified, so a previously intended URL could override the required destination.
Only CHANGELOG.md is updated; setup/architecture docs are not touched for the new auth flow and locale defaults.
The @fonts directive was dropped from the welcome page when moving it to the new layout, an unrequested behavior change.
Title concatenates config('app.name') with ui.layout.title, both 'PegaFila', yielding 'PegaFila - PegaFila'.
Bulma field/label/error markup is repeated across five views instead of an anonymous Blade component as the conventions suggest.

review.summary: The change implements the full session-auth flow (Livewire login/register, logout, password reset, e-mail verification, pt_BR localization) with correct routes, rate limiting and security hardening, and it largely meets the contract. However it ships no tests whatsoever, which the project's mandatory TDD convention treats as blocking, and the Livewire components skip the required #[Validate] pattern; a few minor gaps (untranslated resend status) remain, so it needs substantial rework before approval.
